title: Jorjani's great aunt talking with dead relatives on her deathbed

tellings.quote: one case was my great aunt or I was there while she was like describing to not just not describing she was having conversations with dead relatives

plain: The philosopher Jason Jorjani says that on her deathbed in a hospital room his great aunt was not just describing dead relatives but holding conversations with them. Jorjani tells Michels he was there and saw it himself. He offers it as a case suggesting that the dying may be in contact with the dead.
